walkthrough: Goal: Notan (黑白构图), value masses' two-value variant at Fluent and Steady (Proko's two-value thumbnails): a composition painted in two values only, each big mass decided light or dark, no middle. Not a skill of its own: value masses' lessons at their second and third levels lay it every second lesson (the even ones), on the same compositions whose masses read; Beginning stays three values.

Entry: the composition pack imported (Practice options, Import practice pack…), then a lesson of Value masses at level 2, here its first: Notan. The bar says Value masses 1/1, as the skill's lessons do.

How, first time: Paint the picture in two values; every big mass decided as light or dark, no middle. The example beside its picture: 1 squint, Fill frame with Light; 2 the dark masses with Dark, each one decided (the middle masses merged into the dark); 3 Compare: the answer's greys faint, its mass edges red, a stray strip hatched. One paragraph: a mass between is put with the darks or the lights, whichever keeps the big shapes clear; more than one choice can be right. Got it.

The exercise: the picture with its credit; my frame beside it of its shape. The tools: Dark and Light (each word underlined in its grey), Fill frame with a swatch of the grey in hand, Undo, Redo; no Middle, no Sketch, no Draw. Light is in hand: Fill frame lays the light first.

Fill frame: my frame light (the grey in hand, Light). Dark: the mountain's right part, the tree and the field, decided dark; the mountain's left slope missed (a mistake); Light again: the house's wall over them; the path left dark between my strokes' seams. Compare: the copy read against the answer's middle merged into the dark and into the light; the merge it matches better (here the dark one) laid under the slider in its two greys, its mass edges red (the ridge, the house and the path), the missed slope hatched dark; the seams narrower than the pen unhatched. The card: Original shown, then How close is it?, Accurate, Almost, Again; no number. The slider low: my paint shows through. Almost.
Finish: the lesson's end, Value masses, 1 exercise; That's all for today.
